idea.title: ChangelogGen   Generate conventional changelogs from git commits with conventional commits format

plan.tagline: Generate conventional changelogs from git commits in one command
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small dev teams waste hours manually writing changelogs from git commits, especially when using Conventional Commits format inconsistently.
plan.solution: Parse git commits, validate Conventional Commits format, group changes by type (feat/fix/perf/docs), and output a clean markdown changelog with semantic versioning suggestions. Works offline, integrates with CI/CD via CLI.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small tech teams (1-10 people) who use Git and need professional changelogs without manual effort.
mvp_features: Parse local git commits since last tag
Generate markdown changelog with sections (Features, Fixes, etc.)

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for commit cache + add/list commands

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded commits + edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Run `changeloggen --demo` to see a simulated changelog generated from hardcoded commits (feat, fix, docs) with version v1.2.3 output to stdout.
